transcript:
Speaker A (Voiceover): ऑफिस पार्टी से घर आई। पति ने कुछ नहीं बोला। सीधा कमरे में गया। मैं किचन में खड़ी थी। पता है सबसे बुरा क्या लगता है? जब तुम्हारा अपना आदमी तुमसे शर्मिंदा हो। उस दिन डिसाइड किया, अगली पार्टी में वो प्राउड होगा। [Came home from the office party. Husband said nothing, went straight to the room. I stood in the kitchen. Do you know what feels worst? When your own husband is embarrassed of you. That day I decided, he will be proud at the next party.]
Speaker B: Hi, you must be Rahul's wife. So nice to finally meet you. What do you do?
Speaker A (Mira): आई... होम... काम... घर में... [I... home... work... in the house...]
Speaker B: Oh, that's nice.
Speaker A (Voiceover): HR मुस्कुराई और दूसरे कपल से बात करने लग गई। बॉस की वाइफ आती है। [The HR smiled and started talking to another couple. The boss's wife came.]
Speaker C: Hi dear, where are you from?
Speaker A (Mira): मैं... जयपुर... से... [I... from... Jaipur...]
Speaker C: Oh lovely! Jaipur is beautiful. Do you work or...
Speaker A (Voiceover): मेरा चुप। पति आता है। [I was silent. Husband came.]
Speaker D: Sorry, she's a bit tired today.
Speaker A (Voiceover): घर जाते वक्त गाड़ी में साइलेंस। [Silence in the car on the way home.]
Speaker D: आज अच्छा था पार्टी में? [Was it good at the party today?]
Speaker A (Mira): हाँ। [Yes.]
Speaker A (Voiceover): कोई और बात नहीं, दोनों चुप। उस रात सब सो गए। मैं बाथरूम में बैठकर रोई। सुंदर हूँ, सब कहते हैं। पर सुंदर होने से क्या होता है जब मुंह से एक वर्ड नहीं निकले। शादी की क्योंकि प्रीटी थी, पर पार्टी में प्रीटी से काम नहीं चलता, इंग्लिश चाहिए। उस रात फोन उठाया। इंग्लिश सीखो ऐप डाउनलोड किया। एक रुपये का ट्रायल था। जनरल इंग्लिश शो खोला। हेलो से बात शुरू करें। एक लाख से ज्यादा लोग देख चुके थे। प्ले किया। इतना सिंपल था कि मुझे लगा हाँ ये मैं कर सकती हूँ। रोज रात को पति सो जाता, मैं फोन पे सीखती। अपने बारे में बताऊँ? My name is Mira. I am from Jaipur. I am a homemaker. नाम और सिटी कॉन्फिडेंटली बोलें। अपना नाम और सिटी इंग्लिश में कॉन्फिडेंटली बोलना। अपनी फैमिली इंट्रोड्यूस करें। My husband works at Infosys. We have been married for one year. AI कोच से प्रैक्टिस करती थी। Hi, nice to meet you. I am Mira. I am from Jaipur. I manage our home. I love cooking and reading. गलत बोलती, सुधार देती। 500 बार गलत बोला, 500 बार सुधारा। कभी नहीं बोली, होममेकर है तो तुझे इंग्लिश की क्या जरूरत। तीन महीने बाद दोबारा पार्टी थी ऑफिस की। पति ने बोला, चलना है? मैंने बोला, हाँ। [No other words, both silent. That night everyone slept. I sat in the bathroom and cried. Everyone says I'm beautiful. But what's the use of beauty when you can't speak a word. He married me because I was pretty, but being pretty doesn't work at parties, you need English. That night I picked up my phone and downloaded the English Seekho app. There was a 1 rupee trial. I opened the General English show. Start with Hello. Over 1 lakh people had watched it. I played it. It was so simple I felt I could do it. Every night when my husband slept, I learned on my phone. Tell about myself? My name is Mira. I am from Jaipur. I am a homemaker. Speak name and city confidently. Introduce your family. My husband works at Infosys. We have been married for one year. I practiced with the AI coach. Hi, nice to meet you. I am Mira. I am from Jaipur. I manage our home. I love cooking and reading. If I spoke wrong, it corrected me. I spoke wrong 500 times, corrected 500 times. It never said, you are a homemaker so why do you need English. Three months later, there was another office party. Husband asked, want to go? I said, yes.]
Speaker E: Mira, so good to see you again! How have you been?
Speaker A (Mira): I have been great, thank you. We recently went to Udaipur for our anniversary. The Lake Palace was absolutely beautiful. Have you been there?
Speaker E: Oh wow! No, I haven't. You have to tell me more.
Speaker A (Voiceover): पति दूर से देख रहा था। बॉस आया, बोला, 'Rahul, your wife is very charming.' घर जाते वक्त गाड़ी में पति ने हाथ पकड़ा। बोला, 'आज मुझे प्राउड फील हुआ।' मैंने बोला, 'इंग्लिश सीखो ऐप। रोज 15 मिनट, बस इतना।' इंग्लिश सीखो ऐप डाउनलोड करो। जनरल इंग्लिश शो खोलो। AI कोच से प्रैक्टिस करो। एक रुपये का ख्याल है। अगली पार्टी में चुप मत बैठना। बोलो कॉन्फिडेंटली। पति का चेहरा देखना तब। [Husband was watching from afar. The boss came and said, 'Rahul, your wife is very charming.' On the way home, my husband held my hand and said, 'Today I felt proud.' I said, 'English Seekho app. 15 minutes daily, that's all.' Download the English Seekho app. Open the General English show. Practice with the AI coach. There is a 1 rupee trial. Don't stay silent at the next party. Speak confidently. See your husband's face then.]
Speaker F: तो इंस्टॉल बटन पे क्लिक करो और इंग्लिश सीखो ऐप डाउनलोड करो। [So click on the install button and download the English Seekho app.]

She downloads the English Seekho app, practices daily using the AI coach, and confidently converses in English at the next party, making her husband proud.
